id: title:gantoine:put clickhouse udfs on the python merge queue lanes

review.posthog_relevance: Changes CI gating behavior to include ClickHouse UDF workflow and lane, potentially affecting Python build and migration checks.
review.reason: Adds workflow file and lane configuration to CI gating, changing recognition of ClickHouse UDF and workflow changes as Python-triggered. This is a maintenance and operational change.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies on supplied observations; no independent verification of actual CI behavior or production impact.

observations.limitations: This chunk represents a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs were detected. No score assigned.
